events.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What’s the plan, and what do you need from me?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli — that’s great. I’m thinking we start Saturday morning at the community center, and I could use you to help sort tools and match volunteers to jobs.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Eli: Saturday morning at the community center works for me. I’ll sort the tools and help match volunteers to jobs.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing, where the drop-off is, and whether we need to bring anything specific.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot, and you can just bring any repair items you’ve got or a basic tool kit if you have one.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: That sounds doable, but what time Saturday morning are you thinking? I just want to make sure I can plan around it.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Mina: Sounds good—what date should we put on it?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Quinn: This Saturday morning at the community center lot would be perfect.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Mina: Great, I’ll put down this Saturday morning at the community center lot.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Faye: I can still help coordinate around pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive time and address when you have them.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot—I'll send the exact time and address right over. If you can, bring any repair items or a basic tool kit.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Faye: That should work — send the exact time and address when you have them, and I’ll plan around school pickup. I can also bring a basic tool kit if needed.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: What should I tackle first?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — I’ll get you the repair drive time and address as soon as they’re set.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Leo: Sounds good—just send me the time and address when you have them, and I’ll keep sorting the donated parts.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot, and if you can bring any repair items or a basic tool kit, that’d be great.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Got it — I can bring a basic tool kit this Saturday morning. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you still need.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — a basic tool kit is perfect. I’ll send the exact time and address now, and if anything else comes up I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I’ll send over any specific needs as soon as we lock the plan. If you want, I can also loop in a few more neighbors for Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Sure, feel free to loop them in — I can bring my basic tool kit on Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — send me the exact time and address when you can, and I’ll coordinate around pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact time and address as soon as they’re set, so you can plan around pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you send the time and address, I’ll work the pickup and drop-off around it.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ve still got the tape and screws set aside, and I’m sorting the spare tools. Just send me the time and address for the repair drive, and I’ll help point folks the right way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Cleo! It’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot, and I’ll send the exact time and address right over.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll keep the tape, screws, and spare tools ready. Send the exact time and address when you can, and I’ll help direct folks to the community center lot.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: Got it — Saturday morning at the community center lot. I’ll bring a basic tool kit and see what else I can spare.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll loop in Faye and send the time and address along if anything changes.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — just send me any updates, and I’ll be there Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Rey
